{{Quote|You there, what are you doing with that slave?|The guard questioning Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Slaves of the Republic">{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}}</ref>}}
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], this '''Zygerrian''' was working as a guard in a slave pit on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]].

==Biography==
Following a [[Mission to Zygerria/Legends|mission]] to infiltrate the [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] on Zygerria, [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] arrived at a slave pit to rescue the [[Togruta/Legends|Togrutan]] governor of [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]], [[Roshti/Legends|Roshti]]. The rescue attempt the guards spotted Kenobi taking Roshti. This guard was the first one to see what Kenobi was up, asking him what he was doing with the slave, and alerted the other guards.

==Appearances==
*{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}} {{1st}}
